answer: Each identity claims one cargo slot at a wharf, locking 70 credits. A raven courier carries the claim to an oasis checkpoint, reading the slot log: logged work releases the bond, a missed shift burns it. One assignment serves one slot; filing a rented one twice burns both. The k-th claim pays 25+5(k-1); a thousand fakes pay 2,522,500, with 70,000 locked, versus the 40,000-credit pool. Honest workers claim one slot, do one shift, keep the bond.
